instruction: A candid action photograph, eye-level medium shot, capturing two boxers sparring in an open-air training pavilion with a white metal roof. On the left, the boxer in the blue tank top (R2) stands in profile with black boxing gloves raised in a high guard. On the right, the boxer in the beige t-shirt (R1) faces him in profile, holding his gloves up in a boxing stance. The two face each other closely in defensive postures. Bright daylight fills the pavilion, casting soft shadows under the roof.
elements: R2 raises black boxing gloves in a high guard while facing R1
R1 faces R2 in profile with gloves held up in a boxing stance
R1 and R2 face each other closely in defensive sparring postures
boxing gloves are used as the contact-relevant sparring objects
the sparring takes place in an open-air training pavilion with a white metal roof
